subject: Rapid backfill playbook for candidate track — urgent interviewer swap
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT - interviewer drop for Emma Zhao (onsite: Mon 6/21)

Hi Marcus,

Quick heads up — Emma Zhao is scheduled for an onsite loop at Acme next Monday (6/21). One of the interviewers (backend system design) just went on unexpected PTO and Acme asked if we can provide a substitute who has hands-on system design experience. They prefer someone with recent distributed-systems hiring experience and can do the slot at 2:00–2:45pm PT.

I attached Emma's resume and the current slate. This is time-sensitive — the hiring manager wants the loop to remain intact, and Emma is only available in that window next week. Can Redwood help identify a replacement from our interview panel and a backup shadow in case of last-minute conflicts?

If we can confirm by EOD tomorrow it would keep the loop on schedule.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Patel
Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Acme Robotics

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT - interviewer drop for Emma Zhao (onsite: Mon 6/21)

Team — forwarding for fast triage. TL;DR: need a System Design interviewer for Mon 6/21, 2:00–2:45pm PT + a backup/shadow. Candidate is strong; hiring manager asked to keep loop intact.

Proposed rapid backfill playbook (30–45 min execution):
1) Volunteer primary: confirm slot and calendar invite; block 2:00–2:45pm PT.
2) Assign backup shadow: join muted, take notes, step in if primary drops.
3) Share tailored rubric + two focused prompts (I listed quick rubric bullets below).
4) Confirm with external recruiter and update Onsite ICS + candidate timeline.
5) Post-loop: debrief in Slack #hiring-sd with 1–2 line verdict + rubric scores.

Minimal rubric (for this quick swap):
- System decomposition & tradeoffs (1–5)
- API & data flow clarity (1–5)
- Scaling & failure modes (1–5)
- Communication & mentoring fit (1–5)

Marissa — you have recent distributed systems interviews and are local for that slot. Can you take primary?
Laura/Tessa — if Marissa is available, please propose a backup shadow (or volunteer if Marissa is offline). If none of you can, please suggest someone else on the panel and I'll escalate to staffing.

Sarah — I'll confirm with the candidate once we lock primary/backup.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Recruiting Partner (Interview Ops) — Redwood Inference
Attachments: candidate-timeline-EmmaZhao.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT - interviewer drop for Emma Zhao (onsite: Mon 6/21)

Marcus — I can take the primary System Design slot (2:00–2:45pm PT) and will prepare the short rubric you listed. I'll join the loop via Zoom; Sarah, please send the meeting link or I can use the Acme ICS.

Laura — would you be willing to be the backup shadow? If not, Tessa, would you mind? Backup role: join muted, take notes, and be ready to step in at 10 minutes notice. If either of you can't, I can escalate to the broader panel but that adds churn.

A few quick asks for the replace flow:
- Marcus: drop the 3–4 focused prompts into the calendar invite (I like to keep it focused on one scaling tradeoff + one reliability failure mode)
- Sarah: confirm candidate's timezone and verify no other conflicts.

I'll block my calendar now and add a short pre-brief doc to the event.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks all — quick status:
- Primary: Marissa Cole confirmed (2:00–2:45pm PT) — calendar invite updated.
- Backup shadow: Laura Bennett confirmed (muted, notes, step-in).
- I added the three focused prompts to the event and attached the short rubric.
- Sarah: please send the Zoom link and final candidate logistics. Emma, if you have any access needs please reply to Sarah directly.

Post-loop: Laura and Marissa please paste rubric scores in #hiring-sd within 1 hour of the loop. If either of you ends up stepping out, escalate to me and I'll route a replacement.

Thanks for the quick turn — appreciate the fast pivots.

Marcus
